title: Fix a deliberately broken import: a partition imported from outside its module (all-.cppm)
prompt: In this mcpp C++23 modules project, src/main.cpp is not part of module `calc` and does not compile: it writes `import calc:types;`, trying to import module partition `:types` directly, which is only reachable from within its own module. Fix the import in src/main.cpp so the project builds and its tests pass, without changing what main() does.
